* Supplier A reports that the powder-coating line maintenance has delayed the 1,200 pcs of TW-BTL-750 (Harbour Blue) to a new ready date of 24 October 2026.
* The 800 pcs of TW-BTL-500 are unaffected and will ship on schedule on 10 October 2026.
* The supplier has asked us to confirm the new date for the 750 ml bottles and offered to split the shipment if we need part of the order earlier.

```json
{
  "supplier": "Supplier A Manufacturing Co.",
  "po_number": "PO-20417",
  "lines": [
    {
      "sku": "TW-BTL-750",
      "qty": 1200,
      "status": "delayed",
      "new_date": "2026-10-24",
      "date_text": "24 October",
      "note": "Delayed from 10 October due to scheduled maintenance on the powder-coating line."
    },
    {
      "sku": "TW-BTL-500",
      "qty": 800,
      "status": "confirmed",
      "new_date": "2026-10-10",
      "date_text": "10 October",
      "note": "Not affected, shipping as planned."
    }
  ],
  "needs_person": true,
  "needs_person_reason": "The delivery date for TW-BTL-750 is delayed, and the supplier has asked us to confirm the new date or decide whether to split the shipment.",
  "reply_draft": "Hi Lily,\n\nThanks for the update on PO-20417. We have noted that the 800 pcs of TW-BTL-500 will ship on 10 October as planned. Regarding the delay of the 1,200 pcs of TW-BTL-750 to 24 October, we will check on the new date and whether we need a split shipment, and we will come back to you shortly.\n\nBest regards,\nOperations Team"
}
```

**Summary:**
* Supplier A requested a price increase for PO-20452 on SKU TW-LBX-01 from USD 3.10 to USD 3.29 due to rising resin costs.
* SKU TW-LBX-02 remains at USD 1.45, and production is scheduled to start on 19 October 2026.
* Human approval is needed for the price change and to confirm if we accept the adjustment before production begins.

```json
{
  "supplier": "Supplier A Manufacturing Co.",
  "po_number": "PO-20452",
  "lines": [
    {
      "sku": "TW-LBX-01",
      "qty": 2400,
      "status": "price_change",
      "new_date": null,
      "date_text": null,
      "note": "Unit price increased from USD 3.10 to USD 3.29"
    },
    {
      "sku": "TW-LBX-02",
      "qty": 3600,
      "status": "confirmed",
      "new_date": "2026-10-19",
      "date_text": "19 October 2026",
      "note": "Unit price stays at USD 1.45"
    }
  ],
  "needs_person": true,
  "needs_person_reason": "The supplier is requesting a price increase on SKU TW-LBX-01 and requires approval before production starts on 19 October 2026.",
  "reply_draft": "Hi Kevin,\n\nThank you for your update regarding PO-20452.\n\nWe have noted that production for TW-LBX-02 is scheduled for 19 October 2026 at USD 1.45. Regarding the price increase for TW-LBX-01 from USD 3.10 to USD 3.29, we will check this internally and come back to you shortly.\n\nBest regards,\nOperations Team"
}
```

- Supplier-A cannot supply the Sage green masterbatch for PO-20460 in time and offers Olive green instead, keeping the 2 November 2026 ship date.
- Waiting for Sage green will delay the shipment by about three weeks.
- A human decision is required to either accept the Olive green substitution or wait for Sage green.

```json
{
  "supplier": "Supplier-A",
  "po_number": "PO-20460",
  "lines": [
    {
      "sku": "TW-LID-SAGE",
      "qty": 1500,
      "status": "substitution",
      "new_date": "2026-11-02",
      "date_text": "2 November 2026",
      "note": "Supplier offers Olive green (Pantone 5763 C) as a substitute for Sage green. Waiting for Sage would delay shipment by about three weeks."
    }
  ],
  "needs_person": true,
  "needs_person_reason": "The supplier has offered a product substitution (Olive green instead of Sage green) and is asking us to choose between accepting the substitution or waiting approximately three weeks longer for the original colour.",
  "reply_draft": "Hi Lily,\n\nThank you for updating us on PO-20460 regarding the lid colour.\n\nWe are reviewing the option to substitute with Olive green versus waiting for the Sage green masterbatch, and we will come back to you shortly with our decision.\n\nBest regards,\nOperations Team"
}
```
